from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,shutil,sys,tarfile
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1];sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT/'src'))
from swe_study.audit import Run
from swe_study.common import setup_environment,write_json
setup_environment()
with Run('cloud_archive_validation') as run:
    write_json(run.path/'driver.json',{'source':Path(__file__).read_text()})
    project=ROOT/'.cache/tmp/cloud-evaluation-20261123T223401-be431423'
    metadata=json.loads((project/'checkpoints/step-resume/experiment.json').read_text())
    assert metadata['synthetic_fixture']
    shutil.copy2(ROOT/'scripts/preserve_cloud_results.py',project/'scripts/preserve_cloud_results.py')
    run.command([sys.executable,'scripts/preserve_cloud_results.py','--adapter','checkpoints/step-resume','--archive'],cwd=project,timeout=300)
    archives=list((project/'results/cloud_preservation').glob('*/preservation.tar'))
    assert len(archives)==1
    with tarfile.open(archives[0]) as archive:
        member=next(m for m in archive.getmembers() if m.name.endswith('/preservation_manifest.json'))
        manifest=json.load(archive.extractfile(member))
        for item in manifest['files']:
            data=archive.extractfile('swe-study-a100/'+item['path']).read()
            assert len(data)==item['bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()==item['sha256']
    report={'passed':True,'files':len(manifest['files']),'logical_bytes':manifest['logical_bytes'],
            'archive_sha256':hashlib.sha256(archives[0].read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'synthetic_fixture':True}
    write_json(run.path/'validation.json',report);print(json.dumps(report,indent=2))
